bayts.text: Subdue the sovereigns for me, O Subduer (Al-Qahhār), forever; protect me and suffice me against scheming and against Satan.
I have hoped that You would protect me and help me with a mighty help, as I attain from You Your good pleasure.
You have kept me from the scheming of my enemies and those with them: so keep me forever from rancour and aggression.
Forgive my sins and grant me today what I ask, by Your "Be!" (Kun); and by it set right for me, forever, every state.
Grant me to part from every trait You are not pleased with, and erase from me, O All-Forgiving (Al-Ghaffār), whatever has disfigured me.
By the sanctity of the Chosen One (Muḥammad), whose Servant I have become, in verse and in prose, in rhymed prose and then in metre.
Accept the pilgrimage of my heart and keep me from error; erase what disgraces me and perfect me with what adorns.
O Lord, answer and bring to completion what I have intended at Ṭūbā (Touba), which by You and in You is built as an edifice.
On Saturday I turned my face, content, to Him (Allah) who, eternally, when He says "Be!", it is:
a Generous Lord, Guardian (Al-Ḥafīẓ), Vast, Everlasting Refuge (Aṣ-Ṣamad); and from Him I seek ease and a peaceful abode.
Increase my knowledge today with an increase that heralds for me the opening (fatḥ) and the outpouring (fayḍ), and subdue the jailer for me, for all time.
O Powerful, O Subduer, O Compeller (Al-Jabbār), O my sole aim: subdue for me him who takes wealth without right.
Today I have addressed You in intimate prayer, O Kind One: upon me towards Him lies a thanksgiving that puts ruby and coral to shame.

You are the Most High (Al-ʿAlī), the Immense (Al-ʿAẓīm), the Just (Al-ʿAdl), O my hope; You are the All-Knowing (Al-ʿAlīm), the Forbearing (Al-Ḥalīm), the Kind (Al-Barr), the All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān).
Grant me, by the sanctity of these Names, to subdue him who for long ages has striven against the people of Truth.
From You I have sought what You gave the righteous, so that by it they subdued the enemies unceasingly.
Grant me possession today, O Bestower (Al-Wahhāb), of what I ask, and keep me from the guile of him who, out of greed, has lied.
Today I have addressed You in intimate prayer, in need of You: so be for me the Enricher (Al-Mughnī), and today fling open the doors for me.
Open for me today, through the Chosen One (Al-Mukhtār, Muḥammad), our master, the doors of good that draw provision in its due time.
Be with me in generosity, felicity and mercy, and with glad tidings, O You whose favour is manifest.
Make my life good, without death (of the soul) or harm, and by Your grace let my sojourn, O Lord, be an offering of nearness.
Make easy all that I hope for and seek, until my eye is cooled and my heart rejoices.
O Lord, lead to me in the two abodes (this world and the Hereafter) every wish, and keep me forever from scheming and forsaking.
Make the Truth plain to me through an unveiling (kashf) that never leaves me, just as You unveiled clarity to the people of God (the Saints).
Turn the hearts of the enemies, all together, away from harming me, towards my help, and through me guide elders and youths.
Yesterday I left what I had sold (of myself to You), and it has passed: so change every time to good, and hold every disgrace far from me.
Turn towards me unveiling and fervour (at-taskhīn), without hardship, and keep me forever from ignorance and loss.
O Opener (Al-Fattāḥ), grant me an opening that shows marvels, O Best of guides, who have guided the untried and the bewildered.
I have been the guest of the Generous (Allah), who ever receives His guest with His "Be!"; and the time has come for me to be helped in my Ṭūbā (Touba).
I have been the guest of the Generous (Allah), who honoured me on land and on sea, when He led the Qur'an to me in outpouring.
